format: html

  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
basketball_tibble <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c("Never played", "Brief career", "Solid career", "All-Star level", "Superstar"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c("#1–10", "#11–25", "#26–50", "#51–100", "Outside top 100"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
glimpse(read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx") |>
  select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted) |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(ggrepel)

basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = basketball_tibble |>
      filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
      filter(name %in% c("LeBron James", "Chris Paul", "Kevin Durant", "Dwight Howard")),
    aes(label = name),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Peak Wins Added vs. High School Recruit Rank",
    x = "Recruit Rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career Tier"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
